title: Jason Momoa Gold
description: This resource pack changes everything that has gold in it into Jason Momoa. Don't ask why. It is just a project from another failed resource pack.
body:
This resource pack is what happens when I have an hour of my time to waste and get the stupidest ideas. Enjoy getting jumpscared in caves to this man's face, because it happens to me a lot.


*side-note* There is a low chance that you actually get jumpscared by him, my only point is that you will come across his face lots depending on whether you are mining or not. Enjoy it I guess.
